label: TS-464 4-bay NAS
description: 4-bay desktop NAS with two 2.5GbE RJ45 ports (2.5G/1G/100M) and one PCIe Gen3 x2 slot. 5GbE/10GbE are optional add-in cards, not onboard.
notes: Onboard: 2x 2.5GbE RJ45. PCIe Gen3 x2 slot takes a 5GbE or 10GbE card (low profile, 190 mm). No management/OOB port. WOL supported on the 2.5G ports.
